changes.comment: Edit and publish on a Git working tree in both apps. The content files (`contentFiles`, `ContentFiles` with `apply()`) and the content store move here from `@micacms/connectors`; Publish commits exactly the reviewed paths and refuses a file saved again after the review; an owner policy lets an app keep its own clone in step. The SQLite driver, the draft store and the provider connectors are removed, and `/ready` reports reason codes.
